tools.name: get_gpu_prices
tools.description: Latest GPU rental price index in USD per GPU-hour, with 1D, 1W and 1M changes and a link to each GPU's page. Give one GPU to also get its benchmark contract, each provider's standardized average price, and its compute futures prices: each exchange listing a contract on its rental price, with the exc

tools.name: get_token_prices
tools.description: Latest token price index per AI company in USD per 1M tokens (3 input : 1 output blend), with 1D, 1W and 1M changes. Give one company to also get its models' usage shares and posted prices.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Price history of one GPU (USD per GPU-hour) or one AI company (USD per 1M tokens), oldest first. GPU history is daily from 2025-11-07 for H100 and A100 and from 2026-10-23 for the others, weekly before; token history is daily from 2025-01-01.
